setting.label: Map tooltips
setting.desc: Shows a legend in the corner of the map naming the terrain the party is standing on.

controls.interact: Interact with or dismantle an object
controls.zoomHold: Hold L2 and push the right stick

m721_zone.title: Hydroponic
m721_zone.text: We can use this hydroponic room to grow Earth food in the depths of space.

storyModeWaterfall.title: Secret caves
storyModeWaterfall.text: We should check behind every waterfall: statistically speaking, about 30% of them have a secret cave behind them.

m1006_zone.title: Horse betting
m1006_zone.text: Are you feeling your ludopathy coming back? That's a good sign that your memories are returning, Em! Why don't you bet on horses? Maybe something else will resurface!

m1006_zone2.title: Monster tournament
m1006_zone2.text: Use this terminal to watch and bet on monster fights. I don't really know if they are real monsters fighting for their lives or simulated battles; maybe it's best to just not know.

m1006_zone3.title: Coin conversion
m1006_zone3.text: Use this machine to convert euros to tokens used for minigames and slot machines. You also have a [Hyperdeck] app for that.

m1006_zone4.title: Slot machine
m1006_zone4.text: I heard rumors of a cursed slot in this casino.

m1023_zone.title: Ghent Hospital
m1023_zone.text: Visit hospitals to get our diseases diagnosed, install augments, change body parts and access the [Fertility database]. I don't exactly picture you as a mother figure, but if you want to help repopulate the Earth, go ahead!

m1414_zone.title: Inn
m1414_zone.text: Are you feeling tired, Em? Or do you need to hire some muscle to support your hexing? Visit inns and taverns to rent a room and talk to other adventurers.

m1414_zone2.title: Hypermetro trains
m1414_zone2.text: We can move between hub cities using the hypermetro! Our final destination is the Omega Tower, but we should stop at Ghent to stock up on items. Don't worry, darlin', if we leave our [Camper] behind: it can be summoned by using our [Liminal cuffs].

m1414_zone3.title: Crafting
m1414_zone3.text:
In this shack we can find some materials. It belongs to Xor the trash goblin; I'll repay him later if we take something from here.
You can use the [Thinker] option in [Menu] to assemble anything you have the technical skills for.

m1414_zone4.title: Farming plots
m1414_zone4.text: We can use farming plots to grow our own plants, or just take what we find. Just make sure to pay the owner of the plot back, ok?

m1414_zone5.title: High level enemies
m1414_zone5.text: Darlin', these piles of sentient trash are too strong even for a wannabe witch like you. May I suggest you just ignore them until you can call yourself a proper witch?

m1414_zone7.title: Dungeon
m1414_zone7.text: This dungeon should be a proper challenge to relearn your combat skills! Did I mention that you can modify your [Vector gun] in the [Menu]? You can adapt its alternate form or element to prepare for any situation, and in this dungeon fire damage will help!

m1414_zone10.title: Apiary
m1414_zone10.text: "If the bee disappeared off the surface of the noosphere, then man would only have four years of life left." Aleister Crowley said that.

m1414_zone11.title: Farm
m1414_zone11.text:
We can take over this abandoned farm: its owner was recently killed by satellite debris and nobody has claimed it yet.
Use the [Build] option in the pause menu to buy some animals, but do this only if you want to actually care about them! Do you remember what the Archivists did to our sheep Dolly? I will never forgive them for that!

m1414_zone9.title: Library
m1414_zone9.text: Libraries are a great place to find new grimories, hunting them was your primary hobby before your mind got wiped.

m1414_zone12.title: Clinic
m1414_zone12.text: If you don't feel well, darlin', head to a clinic: there you can get a proper diagnosis and treatment. And if you need a literal hand, you can get new body parts installed and also augments for your body.

m1416_zone.title: PC
m1416_zone.text: Use this public PC to access Hypernet, you can also use the [Hyperdeck] if you don't trust putting your credentials in public PCs.

m1416_zone2.title: Quest board
m1416_zone2.text: You can use the quest board to accept quests, and you can even write your own to be completed by other adventurers.

m1416_zone4.title: Bathroom
m1416_zone4.text: Use bathrooms to wash and raise your hygiene. Hygiene matters when you talk to someone, unless they do not care about it.

m1416_zone5.title: Innkeeper
m1416_zone5.text: Talk to the innkeeper to rent a room, buy food or recruit troops. Yes, you heard right! We can raise an army if we have the funds, and inns are a good place to start. Let's have a beer to our future independent sovereign nation!

m1416_zone15.title: Bathroom
m1416_zone15.text: Use bathrooms to wash and raise your hygiene. Hygiene matters when you talk to someone, unless they do not care about it.

m1416_zone19.title: Minigames
m1416_zone19.text: We can increase our mood by playing games. Some will need game tokens, and we can use this converter or the [Hyperdeck] app to buy them.

m1416_zone10.title: Renting
m1416_zone10.text: Interact with the door or talk to the innkeeper to rent a room. Not sleeping will make you start losing MP and then going insane, so make sure to rest!

m136_zone.title: Omega Tower Entrance
m136_zone.text: Here we are, Em! This is the entrance of the [Omega Tower]: here you have total immunity for your accidental deicide.

m169_zone.title: Abandoned Farm
m169_zone.text: Instead of going to the Omega Tower for immunity, we can also just take over this abandoned farm and stay there until things calm down. We can actually claim any abandoned house we encounter and start placing structures with the [Build] option of the pause menu.

m169_zone2.title: Trash
m169_zone2.text: Ah! Trashdiving! The lottery of the brave! We can find truly marvelous gems that survived the Y2K event buried in trash. I think the trash shielded them from the [EHI] eruption and preserved most of the circuits. Make sure to wash yourself, because being [Oily] makes you vulnerable to fire attacks.

m169_zone3.title: Chaos
m169_zone3.text:
We need to get the hex out of here, Em! The [Fifth dimension] is pouring from holes in reality, and we can easily fall into one and end up in the [White desert].
It's not a nice place, Em. I spent eons trapped there in 1997 before you broke the laws of spacetime to save me.

m169_zone4.title: Materials
m169_zone4.text: We can collect materials by defeating enemies.

m169_zone6.title: Sacrificial altar
m169_zone6.text: This place reeks of gasoline, something powerful is buried there.

m169_zone7.title: Goblins
m169_zone7.text:
Trust me, Em, just leave Nakuga Goblins alone. Let them do their thing and just avoid them if they try to engage in battle. We share a common ancestor and most of our DNA with them, so they are our psionic black metal loving brothers.
Verden Goblins, instead, are a totally different alien species that just happens to look like Earth goblins due to the genetic lottery. They are chill and totally integrated with human society; most goblins you see in town are Verden goblins.

m169_zone8.title: Block pushing puzzle
m169_zone8.text:
Try to solve this simple block pushing puzzle and let me evaluate your mental skills after your memory wipe.
Move toward that boulder to push it and hold [ACTION] to drag it with you

m689_zone.title: Hardware stores
m689_zone.text: You can upgrade your [Hyperdeck] by finding new components in hardware stores.

m689_zone3.title: Garage
m689_zone3.text: We can buy new vehicles in garages, like cars, boats or even a broomstick!

m689_zone5.title: Mages Guild
m689_zone5.text: It's a bit hidden, but this is the entrance to the Ghent mages guild. They don't easily take new associates, but you are already one, so you are free to enter.

m689_zone6.title: Shop tunnel
m689_zone6.text: There are many stores below this tunnel, and it is connected with the other side of the city.

m704_zone.title: Clocktower dungeon
m704_zone.text: We actually already beat this dungeon some years ago, but since it has been reset countless times, it can be good practice to regain some dungeon sense!

m704_zone2.title: Training center
m704_zone2.text: It's a training center, but who needs it honestly? I can be a better tutor than those [Archivist] nerds. Did you know they stole my original drawing sheet for the [Liminal Engine] and sent me a photocopy? They work exactly like the [Great Alexandria Library]: they keep the originals and send you washed out copies!

m704_zone3.title: Bus stop
m704_zone3.text: We can use bus stops to move between any locations in the world.

m704_zone4.title: Fairy maze
m704_zone4.text: Fairies are dangerous, Em! They are living infohazards, and you can't just ignore them like the people on TV. You need to respond to them, be polite and never EVER accept something from them, just refuse... POLITELY!

m708_zone.title: Wilderness
m708_zone.text: Going ahead you can choose to return to the world map or explore the wilderness around Ghent.

m1414_zone13.title: Diving
m1414_zone13.text: I spotted a treasure under this pond; you can dive to reach it. Remember that when fighting in water, you and the enemies take extra damage from electrical attacks.

m1414_zone15.title: Esoteric Shop
m1414_zone15.text: In [Esoteric shops] you can buy magical equipment, alchemistry kits and reagents. Did you know that the owner of this shop worked at [Cern]?

m1414_zone16.title: Armory shop
m1414_zone16.text: Visit armories and gun shops to buy new weapons and gear that you can equip in the [Equip] section of [Menu].

m1414_zone17.title: Wilderness
m1414_zone17.text: Going ahead you can choose to return to the world map or explore the wilderness around Icebush.

m1414_zone18.title: Wilderness
m1414_zone18.text: Going ahead you can choose to return to the world map or explore the wilderness around Icebush.

m1414_zone19.title: Wilderness
m1414_zone19.text: Going ahead you can choose to return to the world map or explore the wilderness around Icebush.

m1414_zone20.title: Slimes
m1414_zone20.text: Every slime has a particular elemental weakness and resists physical attacks.

m1414_zone21.title: Block pushing puzzle
m1414_zone21.text:
Ohh another block pushing puzzle!
Move toward that boulder to push it and hold [Shift] to drag it with you.

m1415_zone.title: Block pushing puzzle
m1415_zone.text:
A block pushing puzzle PLUS an ice floor! Can you solve it for me, Em? I need to test your puzzle solving skills to determine how much of you is left in your soul.
Move toward that boulder to push it and hold [Shift] to drag it with you

m1415_zone2.title: Pre Y2K Cache
m1415_zone2.text: This is a cache of items locked since the Y2K! Let's loot everything, and be careful not to be overencumbered by all the loot. Carrying capacity increases with your [COS] and with more party members following.

m1415_zone3.title: Unfinished puzzle
m1415_zone3.text: I think the guy who built this dungeon ran out of funds when building this room, but it was very promising.

m1415_zone4.title: Ice block puzzle
m1415_zone4.text: Solving this other puzzle should give me a baseline reading of your puzzle solving skills, if you want more complex puzzles to solve we can head to the [Trick castle].

m1415_zone5.title: High level enemies
m1415_zone5.text: There is a swarm of cryodrones trapped in this cave. They are above our current combat level, so we should move past them and run if we end up in battle with them. You don't want to get frozen solid, and neither do I.

m1415_zone6.title: Fog of war
m1415_zone6.text: You can activate the [Fog of war] in [Options] to remove your glasses and have your vision limited. It's your choice, really.

m503_zone.title: Underground Arena
m503_zone.text: We can earn some serious euros by fighting in the arena: we can bring our own equipment or borrow weapons from the arena stash.

m635_zone.title: Dungeon entrance
m635_zone.text:
This is the main staircase. Above us are 92 floors robbed from 92 different dimensions and skewered on the tower.
And under us there are another 92 underground floors, even more brutal than the upper ones.

m635_zone2.title: The hall
m635_zone2.text: Inactive party members will just chill out here if you don't assign them to owned buildings or bases in the [Dynamics] menu. You can ask them to join our party if you have a free spot.

m1073_zone.title: Platforming
m1073_zone.text: This tower has a dimensional anomaly caused by the [Squishing]. I'm feeling very bidimensional.

m689_zone7.title: Casino
m689_zone7.text: This is the Ghent casino, Em! You loved gambling here before your mind got wiped. I think the whole deicide spell backfiring cured you of your ludopathy.

m708_zone2.title: Explorers bar
m708_zone2.text: I love this little bar. The owner is undead and is cursed to serve here for all eternity... well, at least until 2012, when there will be no Earth anymore. He maintains the Neapolitan tradition of the suspended coffee.

m714_zone.title: Hypermodern art
m714_zone.text: It may seem like a heist, but it's just hypermodern art.

m721_zone2.title: Returning temple
m721_zone2.text: Ring the gong to return to the Omega Tower, no matter how distant we are from Earth.

m721_zone3.title: Space exploration
m721_zone3.text: Here we are, Em! The final frontier! Open the [Star Map] to plot our next course. I talked with commander Hack; he trusts me enough to pilot this thing.

m1036_zone.title: Stock options
m1036_zone.text: Buying Lime corp stocks is a good starting point if you want to start investing. You can buy and sell in the stocks [Hyperdeck] app.

m1036_zone2.title: Crime and punishment
m1036_zone2.text: Remember, Em: the police serve Justice, so they automatically serve Eris, my ex-wife. If you commit a crime and they catch you, please pay your bounty or go to prison; never face Eris directly. She hates your guts.

m1036_zone3.title: Helicopter ride
m1036_zone3.text: We can book a helicopter ride to the Omega tower from this helicopter pad.

m1039_zone.title: Cursing temple
m1039_zone.text: I read in the Ghent tourist guide that if you even put a foot in this temple you will be cursed. The guide doesn't state the nature of the curse.

m1415_zone7.title: Locked doors
m1415_zone7.text:
These types of doors are fueled directly by the leyline and cannot be opened without a [Dungeon key].
The good thing is that we can use any dungeon key with any of these doors in any place in the universe.

m1415_zone8.title: Inner waterfall
m1415_zone8.text: I told you, Em! There was a secret cave and an even secreter waterfall all along!

m1415_zone9.title: Bear mauling cave
m1415_zone9.text: Holy hexing shit, we are getting mauled by a bear like I told you!!! RUN!

m169_zone5.title: Hyperviolence
m169_zone5.text: We don't have to punch new holes into every enemy we encounter Em, use the [Talk] option in battle to use diplomacy. Or just shut their mouths with the [Wrestle] option if talking doesn't work darlin'.

m721_zone5.title: Television
m721_zone5.text: This television has prerecorded episodes because once we are far from Earth the signal can't reach us. Remember Em, we don't know exactly the nature of your infohazard so don't respond even to prerecorded footage ok?

m1006_zone5.title: Pool table
m1006_zone5.text: Wanna play pool, Em? I do.

m1414_zone8.title: Quick check
m1414_zone8.text:
Before we continue our adventure Em, make sure to check the [Equip] options and [Skill] option in [Menu] to change your equipment and skills you carry in battle.
You can have up to 9 skills and spells in battle.

m635_zone3.title: Missile launch railgun
m635_zone3.text: If we prove our worthiness by surviving an orbital ascent through the Kessler field, we gain the right to teleport directly to the ESA ship orbiting outside the belt. I'm a big fan of [Director Hack], who is the head of [ESA]. Did you know that she is still an atheist even though the existence of multiple gods has been confirmed? She is so badass!

m635_zone4.title: Elevator
m635_zone4.text: We can use the elevator to return to any floor we first reached on foot, plus the Hypermetro station and Omega City many floors down. The elevator is sentient: it can recognize faces and lock floors based on who visits.

m635_zone5.title: Hypermetro stairs
m635_zone5.text: Use these stairs to reach the Hypermetro station.

m102_zone.title: Elevator
m102_zone.text: This is the main elevator, we can use it to reach any discovered floor of this tower.

m102_zone2.title: Training center
m102_zone2.text: Did you see the training center at Ghent? In reality it's a fake building that, on entry, transports you to the interior of this training center. I was hired to design the mechanism; it's not magical, it's pure physics!

findTheInn.title: Somewhere to sleep
findTheInn.text: The inn stands at the middle of the station. Follow the lit windows and ask the landlord for a bed.

seeTheDoctor.title: See the doctor
seeTheDoctor.text: The clinic is the low building with the white door. Whatever is broken gets set in there.

searchTheWagons.title: Search the wagons
searchTheWagons.text: The siding has not been picked clean. Open every crate before the light goes.

intoTheCaves.title: Into the caves
intoTheCaves.text: The mouth in the hill runs deeper than it looks. Take a light, and something to swing.

headOutside.title: Head outside
headOutside.text: There is nothing more for you indoors. Step out and take the road.
